about.title: One company. Two connected engines of growth.
about.intro: DMG segments itself into two business lines under the Core data center infrastructure and Core+ software and services strategies, unified through its vertical integration.
about.coreDescription: Our Core strategy drives revenue from Bitcoin mining, AI compute and colocation services.
about.corePlusDescription: Our Core+ strategy drives revenue from DMG’s carbon-neutral Bitcoin ecosystem, digital-asset custody services, Terra Pool and other Blockseer-enabled products and services.
